invariants.rationale: context is used in the constructor call and is cast to HoodieJavaEngineContext, so it must be non-null.
instantTime is passed to an action executor; it represents a commit time and should not be null.
preppedRecords is passed to an executor and must be non-null for successful operation.
Size of any Java List is always non-negative.
If the list is empty, its size is zero.
